byte_shape: 14 frames, each 10 MiB padding plus native envelope and 80 relevant transactions

clock.advancement: integer microseconds; setup frozen; explicit execution schedule only
clock.economic_event: immutable event bytes constructed from declared economic clock before execution
clock.economic_now: wall; ages advance with wall even during stalled source
clock.observer: real monotonic perf_counter_ns; only future paired measurement; never modeled timing
clock.recovery: native latched source-origin+120; persists across restart
clock.residence: wall minus original event time (first_seen only when no event time)
clock.source: fixed finalized block timestamp; never receive-time substitution

construction: pure preconstruction; no real time calls
continuity: require covered pumpswap 1000..1012; zero capacity disconnect/overflow
finalized_timestamp: declared source/economic timestamp, never refreshed by recv
